text_excerpt: Immuvera Therapeutics | Our Solution Company Our Solution News Contact us Our Solution Market Opportunity A One Health Opportunity Cancer is one of the leading causes of death in dogs, and owners increasingly seek the same standard of care they would expect for a family member. Yet treatment options remain limited: surgery, chemotherapy and radiation are costly, not widely available, and rarely control cancer once it has spread. The same is true in people. Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer death worldwide, and the lungs are a common site of metastasis. A therapy proven against lung metastases in dogs therefore addresses an unmet need in two species, through one programme. Market demand is growing rapidly as Millennials and Gen Z, now major pet owners, drive pet humanization and demand for advanced care, with pet insurance seeing significant growth now covering cancer therapy.
